mapper.select: SELECT MAX(c.CLOSE_YM) FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=#{month} AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "projectType", m.DEV_ID AS "developerId",COALESCE(d.DEV_NM,m.DEV_ID) AS "developerName", a.INPUT_BGN_DT AS "inputStart",a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputType", m.MON_MM AS "monthlyMm",COALESCE(m.APLY_UPRC,0) AS "billingPrice",m.SALES_AMT AS "salesAmount" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=m.DEV_ID WHERE m.INPUT_YM=#{month} AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD IN ('MO','DP') AND a.INPUT_TYPE_CD<>'FREE' AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' ORDER BY p.PROJ_NM,p.PROJ_ID,m.ASGN_ID
mapper.sql: SELECT b.BILL_ID AS "billId",b.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", COALESCE(c.CLNT_NM,'') AS "customerName",p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "projectType", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "projectStatus",p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "projectStart",p.CTRT_END_DT AS "projectEnd", b.BILL_ORD AS "billOrder",b.BILL_YM AS "billMonth",b.BILL_DT AS "billDate", b.SPLY_AMT AS "supplyAmount",b.VAT_RT AS "vatRate",b.VAT_AMT AS "vatAmount", b.TOT_AMT AS "totalAmount",b.RCPT_SUM_AMT AS "receiptSumAmount",b.UNPAID_AMT AS "unpaidAmount", b.PAY_DUE_DT AS "payDueDate",b.TAX_INVC_NO AS "taxInvoiceNo",(b.CNCL_YN='Y') AS "cancelled", b.CNCL_RSN AS "cancelReason",b.CNCL_USER_ID AS "cancelledBy",b.CNCL_DTTM AS "cancelledAt" FROM TB_BL_BILL b JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=b.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=p.CUST_CLNT_ID
mapper.select: WHERE b.BILL_YM=#{month} AND b.CNCL_YN='N' ORDER BY b.BILL_ORD DESC,b.BILL_ID DESC

SELECT r.RCPT_ID::text AS "receiptId",r.RCPT_DT AS "receiptDate",r.RCPT_AMT AS "amount", (r.CNCL_YN='Y') AS "cancelled",r.CNCL_RSN AS "cancelReason", r.CNCL_USER_ID AS "cancelledBy",r.CNCL_DTTM AS "cancelledAt", (r.CNCL_YN='N' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_CL_CLOSE c WHERE c.CLOSE_YM=to_char(r.RCPT_DT,'YYYYMM') AND c.CLOSE_STAT_CD='CLOSE')) AS "canCancel" FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.BILL_ID=#{id} ORDER BY r.RCPT_DT,r.RCPT_ID
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.RCPT_AMT),0) FROM TB_BL_RCPT r WHERE r.BILL_ID=#{id} AND r.CNCL_YN='N'
SELECT b.BILL_ID FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE b.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND b.CNCL_YN='N' ORDER BY b.BILL_ORD DESC,b.BILL_ID DESC LIMIT 1

UPDATE TB_BL_BILL SET SPLY_AMT=#{amounts.supplyAmount},VAT_RT=#{amounts.vatRate}, VAT_AMT=#{amounts.vatAmount},TOT_AMT=#{amounts.totalAmount},RCPT_SUM_AMT=#{receipts}, UNPAID_AMT=#{amounts.totalAmount}-#{receipts},BILL_DT=#{input.billDate}, PAY_DUE_DT=#{input.payDueDate},TAX_INVC_NO=#{input.taxInvoiceNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=clock_timestamp() WHERE BILL_ID=#{billId} AND CNCL_YN='N'
